text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant orders inquiry into Gozo Channel company. Sant acted after a government consultant reported serious management shortcomings. Gozo Channel is a state owned company operating the ferry service to the sister island of Gozo.

- Government, in White Paper on tourism, proposes setting up an Authority to promote and enforce tourism standards and promote Malta. Much of that is now done by the National Tourism Orgnisation but the new authority will have more enforcement powers.

- Armed robbers hold up two employees at a supermarket and make off with a considerable but undisclosed amount of cash. They escaped in a car belonging to one the employees which also carried the day's takings from another supermarket.
